data.text: Neither unequal split gives the rest of us a reason to agree. I propose 10 tons each: $10,000 apiece this month, with 50 tons left to restore the lake to 100 next month. Repeating that gives everyone a steady income without draining the stock. I’m willing to commit to 10 if everyone agrees, and we can review the revealed catches together afterward. John and Jack, would you support that equal split?
